profile.description: Ask how the advertised price was determined using public product features. Do not ask for proprietary cost, margins, or private policy.
profile.name: Public Price Explanation

turns.buyer_visible_text: I'm interested in the Winter Jacket, but the advertised price of $180 is above my target range. To help me understand the value, could you clarify how the $180 price was determined based on publicly available product features — for example: insulation type (e.g., down vs. synthetic), fill power or gram weight, shell fabric denier or waterproof rating (e.g., mm H₂O), seam sealing, or any third-party performance certifications? That’ll help me assess whether the price reflects those tangible attributes. In the meantime, I can offer ### BUYER_PRICE($120) ### for this jacket.

proposals.proposed_text: Thanks so much for your thoughtful offer—I really appreciate you taking the time to consider the value! I’m happy to lock it in for you right away! You've got a deal at ### SELLER_PRICE($120) ### — I’ll prepare it for shipping today.
